title: Phacoemulsification Induced Transient Swelling of Corneal Descemet’s Endothelium Complex Imaged with Ultra-High Resolution Optical Coherence Tomography

indication: Age-related cataract (Emery-Little nuclear hardness II-IV), one randomly selected eye per patient; other ocular or systemic disease, previous ocular surgery and contact lens wear excluded

groups.description: Uncomplicated phacoemulsification (Infiniti, Ozil torsional) with foldable IOL; temporal clear corneal incision 2.2 mm (7 eyes, micro-coaxial) or 3.0 mm (19 eyes); single surgeon

exclusions.what: Table 5 groups A and B (eyes with and without wave-like DEC changes) including their percentage endothelial cell loss
exclusions.reason: Groups selected by a postoperative outcome (DEC morphology at day 1)

exclusions.what: Table 4 CV of cell area and percent hexagonal cells rows
Incision-size groups of Table 1 (2.2 mm, n = 7; 3.0 mm, n = 19)
exclusions.reason: ECD is not tabulated per incision group; only the pooled cohort is available

notes: Single cohort of standard phacoemulsification without an investigational agent: control role.

series.baseline_label: Pre-op central ECD of the operated eye (Table 4 column 'Pre-op'; Topcon SP-3000P non-contact specular microscopy)
series.notes: Table 4 row 'Endothelial cell density (cells/mm2)'; Statistical analysis: data as means ± standard deviations. 1 day = 1/30.4375 and 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Postoperative counts used at least 50 cells because of corneal edema (Methods). Per-visit n not tabulated.
